description.raw: '''Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast:''' '''Sett''' [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] regenerates「 an additional 0.075 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.025 / 1.05 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] health every 0.5 seconds per [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 5% of his '''missing''' health. 」「 up-to an additional 1.425 / 4.75 / 9.5 / 19 / 19.475 / 19.95 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] health per 0.5 seconds, with the maximum reached at the threshold of [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 95% '''missing''' health. 」
description.text: Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast: Sett  regenerates「 an additional 0.075 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.025 / 1.05 (based on level)Category:Debug health every 0.5 seconds per  5% of his missing health. 」「 up-to an additional 1.425 / 4.75 / 9.5 / 19 / 19.475 / 19.95 (based on level)Category:Debug health per 0.5 seconds, with the maximum reached at the threshold of  95% missing health. 」

description2.raw: '''Innate - Heavy Hands:''' '''Sett's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] alternate between his Left Punch and a Right Punch [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]]. '''Sett''' begins attacking with his Left Punch, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a Right Punch.
description2.text: Innate - Heavy Hands: Sett's basic attacks alternate between his Left Punch and a Right Punch on-attack. Sett begins attacking with his Left Punch, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a Right Punch.

description3.raw: '''Sett's''' Right Punch is empowered to gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range (unless ''[[File:Sett Knuckle Down.png|20xpx|border|link=Sett#Knuckle Down|An icon for Sett's ability Knuckle Down]] [[Sett#Knuckle Down|Knuckle Down]]'' is active), attack at 8 times the Left Punch's attack speed, and deal 5 – 100 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 55% '''bonus''' AD) '''bonus''' physical damage.
description3.text: Sett's Right Punch is empowered to gain  50 bonus range (unless Knuckle Down is active), attack at 8 times the Left Punch's attack speed, and deal 5 – 100 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 55% bonus AD) bonus physical damage.
